messages:
maria: noticed increased mTLS handshake failures in eu-west and ap-northeast after last night's RBAC consolidation. Error from proxies: "keystore unwrap denied". Anyone touching keystore roles?

josh: I did a keystore role consolidation (keystore-reader -> keystore-operator) to reduce role count. Change went out at 2026-03-22T00:30Z. Should have included kms:Decrypt.

lee: logs show KMS AccessDenied for principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/keystore-operator when calling kms:Decrypt for alias/keystore-main. sample req: 9b7e4a.

deploy-bot: deployment:rbac/keystore-role-change succeeded in 3 regions (eu-west, ap-northeast, ap-south) at 2026-03-22T00:31:20Z

oncall: paging SRE. This is impacting inter-service TLS for several tenants in eu-west; degradation is visible.

maria: can we temporarily add broad decrypt permission to keystore service role while we fix policies?

josh: adding role to key policy is quickest but needs key-owner approval. Alternatively revert role rename. Which is faster?

lee: quick check: CloudTrail shows kms:Decrypt denied entries for the time window. key-policy still lists the old role ARN, not the new one. So key-policy update failed during the consolidated rollout.

maria: action items:
- (P0) add keystore-operator to KMS key policy in eu-west and ap-northeast (lee) ETA 20m
- (P0) revert role rename if policy update can't be applied quickly (josh) ETA 15m
- export failing req ids and cert refresh jobs (maria) ETA 30m
- create alert for keystore unwrap_denied > 0.5% (oncall) ETA 1h

josh: executing revert path now: iamctl revert role/keystore-operator-rename --force

lee: I'm patching KMS policy for alias/keystore-main in eu-west: adding principal arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/keystore-operator. Will repeat for ap-northeast after confirmation.

deploy-bot: iamctl: role revert completed at 2026-03-22T01:02:12Z

lee: policy patch done in eu-west. waiting propagation. canary decrypt in 60s.

maria: running canary against proxy in eu-west: curl -H "x-req-id: canary-eu-01" https://keystore.eu-west.internal/decrypt -d '{"key":"alias/keystore-main","cipher":"..."}'

lee: canary succeeded, decrypt_ms=28 req_id=canary-eu-01. Error rate trending down.

oncall: scheduling cert refresh backfill for affected tenants. will monitor 2h.

maria: follow-ups: add deployment gate that diffs KMS key policies against role ARNs before RBAC renames; add unit test for keypolicy updater; add alert for KMS AccessDenied spikes. I'll own the postmortem.

josh: also add step to rotate key-policy updates in a single-region first, validate, then rollout.

maria: thanks all. leaving keystore-operator principal in key policies for 24h as a safety window. File incident: INC-2026-0446.
